The whole exchange lasted 70 seconds. Unlike the Ryan call in the same recording, there was no realistic window in which the opening phase could have run, so this is not_applicable rather than a miss.

notes: Not a scoreable call — 70 seconds, entirely logistics. Recording the rep's judgement as correct: with 25 minutes before a medical appointment, rescheduling rather than compressing a 45-to-60 minute discovery was the right call. The process point worth a manager's attention is that no new time was agreed and rebooking was handed back to a setter, which is a weaker outcome than the live reschedule the rep achieved with the other prospect in the same recording.
